data.name: Rajindar
data.gender_notes: Rajindar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over kings and kingdoms, a powerful and wise ruler, a king who is a wise leader. The name Rajindar carries the meaning “Ruler of Kings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajindar usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of kings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who embodies the divine power of ruling over the self and the universe, a spiritual king who leads others towards enlightenment.
data.etymology: Rajindar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of Kings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajindar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rajindar signifies power, wisdom, and leadership in Hindu culture. Many rulers and kings in Hindu history have had names beginning with 'Raj' or 'Raja' which signify king or ruler in Sanskrit. The name Rajindar was likely given to a person who was expected to rule wisely and justly, to bring prosperity and stability to their realm.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rajindar also holds spiritual significance. In Hinduism, a ruler or king is seen as a representative of the divine on earth. A wise and just ruler is believed to have the support of the gods, and thus the name Rajindar could be seen as a reminder to live in a way that is guided by wisdom and compassion, just as a righteous ruler would govern their kingdom. Alternatively, the name Rajindar could be seen as a reminder to strive to be a leader in one's own life, to guide oneself with wisdom and strength, and to bring positive change and growth to one's own world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rajindar: Ruler of Indra's mind or inner wisdom. Symbolizes the mastery over one's thoughts and emotions, embodying the virtues of courage, wisdom, and leadership.
